## Summary

Bring up a `stellar/quickstart` container, deploy the registry and a reward token, register a demo task and run keeper-bot against it, with one script.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One command reaches a state where the bot executes the demo task.
- [ ] The script prints every contract ID and is safe to re-run.
